Drew: helpful with devices, cautious about ability
Drew often helps relatives reconnect devices and likes patiently testing one possible fix at a time. Drew worries about not being a math genius and reports wanting support, despite interest in practical computer work. The goal is useful service and steady income, with college or certificates available to compare rather than an assumed research career.
Fictional development case. Includes shared scripted defaults.

Years start once you finish the required training. Later amounts are planning estimates, not measured salaries at exact years or guaranteed raises.
More info · salary sources
Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX · May 2025. These figures show employee pay, not a business’s sales. Source years are preserved; future inflation and promotions are not added.
Starting pay uses TWC’s mean of the lowest-paid third, an entry proxy rather than observed first-job pay. Later planning amounts move 45%, 75%, and 100% of the gap toward the occupation’s experienced-wage benchmark, subject to the starting-pay floor and local wage bounds. TWC’s experienced wage is the mean of the upper-paid two-thirds; where suppressed, the sourced local median is used. These fractions are planning assumptions, not a fitted experience-year series.
Employee wage estimates exclude self-employed workers, unincorporated owners, and business profit.
TWC entry proxy is the mean of the lowest-paid third, not observed pay at a particular year. Experience scenarios are separate editorial assumptions.
Mean wage of the lowest-paid one-third of workers in the selected occupation and location. It is an entry wage proxy, not observed pay by years of experience.
Assumes technical skill development in the same occupation. No automatic move into management or executive compensation.
Figures hold purchasing power constant. No future inflation is added. Future labor-market conditions and personal outcomes can differ.
Entry means a first full-time qualified job after required preparation. Experience years begin there; education and apprenticeship years are separate.
2025 Annual MSA Wages · Entry wage proxy ↗
· Texas Workforce Commission / Labor Market Information Mean wage of the lowest-paid one-third of workers in the selected occupation and location. It is an entry wage proxy, not observed pay by years of experience.
OEWS May 2025 ↗
· U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via O*NET OnLine Local wage anchor; all experience ratios are Fieldguide assumptions.
How to use occupational wages ↗
· U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Wage variation guidance; does not publish experience-year estimates.
Entry and experienced wage definitions ↗
· Texas Workforce Commission Entry is the mean of the lowest-paid third; experienced is the mean of the upper-paid two-thirds. These groups are not years of experience.
Published experienced-wage anchor ↗
· Texas Workforce Commission Average of the upper-paid two-thirds; not measured pay at a particular experience year.
